name: numerical-research-kit
description: Local numerical error and declared-cost comparisons with checkable saved records.

interface.longDescription: Compare baseline and candidate numerical predictions against reference values. Inspect mean squared error, declared costs and fixed-correction bounds, then freeze and verify saved records. Includes deterministic Python tools, strict input checks and a synthetic solver example. Requires Python 3.9 or later and file execution. Costs and references are supplied by the user; no automatic cost measurement, statistical confidence or scientific certification is provided.
defaultPrompt: Compare my baseline and candidate predictions against these reference values.
Check whether this fixed correction can justify its declared computational cost.
Verify this saved numerical comparison and show every failed case.
